name: Gau-Odernheim (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gau-Odernheim (a black eagle with a human face on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Gau-Odernheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gau-Odernheim arms — eagle with human face on yellow
